inspectionInstructions: Items offered for sale are sold “as is / where is” subject to sale terms and conditions. Most items are used and may  contain defects. Bidders may inspect the property prior to bidding. Inspection is by appointment only. Please use  the 'Ask your question' feature to schedule an appointment for Inspection. Any items that can sometimes be seen in the distance in the pictures, but are not described nor attached to the  listed item are not the subject of sale.
paymentInstructions: Wire Transfer is the only payment option for this item. The Wire Transfer Transaction Summary page will provide  payment and account information. The Wire Transfer must be completed within 5 business days unless otherwise  specified below. Payment instructions: Payments must be made by bank transfer unless otherwise stated. To  obtain  payment information, log into your account and select 'My Bids'. Please follow the checkout procedure. Payment in  full is due not later than five (5) business days from the time and date of the close of the auction.
removalInstructions:
Items may be removed by appointment only. All items must be removed within the removal period stated on the event page. The Buyer is responsible for all arrangements and work related to the removal of the assets unless otherwise stated and must adhere to the site-specific health and safety requirements. LSI or any of its group of companies does not act as shipper or exporter of record without its express consent.
For EU located assets, non-EU buyers need to engage a customs broker / freight forwarder if exporting assets outside of the EU.
For UK located assets, non-UK buyers need to engage a customs broker / freight forwarder if exporting assets outside of the UK.
If asset is located outside of UK or EU, bidders should adapt clause above accordingly.
specialInstructions: Please note: If you are the winning bidder and default on your purchase in any way, your account may be locked,  and you will be unable to bid on future sales. Please familiarise yourself with the event’s specific terms &  conditions.
